EcrDeliveryOptionDetails.UsageInstructions: Deploy this container image in Amazon ECS or Amazon EKS. Use the buyer-owned deployment templates at https://github.com/yumaitau/DingoDocs-aws-deploy. Run the bundled node dist/migrate.cjs migration command before starting the application. Configure PostgreSQL, S3-compatible evidence storage, IAM, TLS, backups, identity, and email for your environment. Product information and legal terms are at https://dingodocs.yumait.au/.
EcrDeliveryOptionDetails.Description: Deploy DingoDocs as a self-hosted security assessment delivery workspace inside your AWS environment.
